page: Microsoft Azure E96-48ads_v7 is a constrained-core, memory-optimized virtual machine provisioned on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It runs on an x86_64 AMD EPYC 9V45 processor capable of clock speeds up to 4.5 GHz, utilizing 48 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 24 physical cores with multithreading enabled. The instance is paired with 768.0 GB of RAM, offering a high allocation of 16.0 GB per vCPU. Local storage is provided through a high-capacity 5670 GB NVMe SSD, while no discrete GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses are bundled with this configuration.

Benchmark results demonstrate strong computing and compression throughput. The instance achieves top-tier performance in single-core stress-ng tests (3775.28) and single-threaded data compression, reaching 41.42 GB/sec in gzip compression and 18.08 GB/sec in bzip3 decompression. Multi-core compute performance remains in the top quartile across stress-ng (89048.42) and PassMark CPU metrics (78218.98). Memory subsystem benchmarks show high cached throughput at 4989.53 GB/sec for small read blocks and 99.65 GB/sec for large write blocks, though large uncached reads register within the middle 50% tier at 156.1 GB/sec.

The constrained-core layout of the E96-48ads_v7 offers distinct cost efficiency for software environments licensed per core, such as enterprise relational database engines. By restricting the vCPU count to 48 while retaining the full 768.0 GB memory footprint and 5670 GB NVMe local disk, users reduce per-core licensing expenses while maintaining high memory density and local I/O performance. In transactional workloads, it sustains strong throughput, delivering 76.45 million operations per second in Redis SET tests and 29451.72 in PassMark database operations.

This server type is primarily fitted for large-scale in-memory databases, relational database engines with high RAM requirements, big data caching tiers, and data analytics pipelines requiring significant temporary NVMe storage. It also supports CPU-based inference workloads, executing small model text generation in the top tier at 410.07 tokens/sec.
description: Microsoft Azure E96-48ads_v7 is a memory-optimized virtual machine featuring 48 dedicated vCPUs derived from 24 physical cores on an AMD EPYC 9V45 processor clocked up to 4.5 GHz. Configured with a constrained-core architecture, it combines 768.0 GB of system memory (16.0 GB per vCPU) with 5670 GB of fast local NVMe SSD storage, without discrete GPUs. In performance benchmarks, the instance demonstrates top-tier single-core compute and gzip compression, alongside strong multi-core processing, PassMark database operation scores, and Redis throughput exceeding 76 million operations per second. The high memory-to-core ratio provides favorable qualitative cost efficiency for software stacks licensed per CPU core that require expansive RAM. The E96-48ads_v7 is well suited for memory-intensive relational databases, large-scale Redis deployments, in-memory caching, and local storage-dependent data analytics workflows.
